themes.label: Recommender systems & search
themes.text: How to pick the right item for the right person: scalable autoencoders, cold start, honest evaluation and search. Most of it runs in production at Recombee.

themes.label: Language models, agents & AI safety
themes.text: Text, explanations and AI agents: what language models know, how agents divide work in marketplaces, and how to keep chatbots safe, also for children.

themes.label: AI for science, health & climate
themes.text: Machine learning on real measurements: weather nowcasting, climate and rural data, fluid simulations, medicine and forensic anthropology.

themes.label: Education, society & applied AI
themes.text: AI for learning and for the people around it: education data, startups, skills and academia-industry matching.

themes.label: Neural networks & optimization
themes.text: Neural networks, evolutionary algorithms and learned optimizers; from neuroevolution to transformers.

themes.label: Data mining, clustering & visualization
themes.text: Finding structure in data: clustering (Chameleon), anomalies, time series and interactive visualization.

themes.label: Inductive modelling, meta-learning & AutoML
themes.text: Letting algorithms build models: the GAME method, meta-learning templates, Predictor Factory and automated data mining.

eras.title: Inductive modelling
eras.text: Student and Ph.D. years with prof. Miroslav Šnorek, starting from the GMDH method. The GAME method grows networks of heterogeneous neurons from data; ensembles of such models estimate their own credibility. First applications in medicine: sleep stages, atrial electrograms, fetal weight.

eras.title: Meta-learning and data mining
eras.text: At the new FIT CTU: meta-learning templates that combine models, the FAKE GAME open-source system, continuous optimization libraries, feature ranking, clustering and text mining. Most theses of this era build predictive models for real data.

eras.title: From AutoML to recommender systems
eras.text: Recombee is founded and the group turns to recommendation. In parallel: learning from relational data (Predictor Factory), multi-objective clustering (Chameleon 2) and predictive ensembles for transfer learning. The first doctoral students defend.

eras.title: Deep learning in practice
eras.text: Scalable shallow autoencoders (ELSA, VASP) and honest offline evaluation of recommenders; learned optimizers and physics-informed weather nowcasting with Meteopress; awards at NeurIPS, KDD and AAAI workshops.

eras.title: Recommendation meets language models
eras.text: Language and interaction signals merge (beeFormer, sparse embeddings), LLMs get explained and guarded (SHIELD, child-safety alignment, geo-grounded guardrails), AI agents start shopping on both sides of a marketplace, EU projects bring climate and rural data. RecSys 2025 comes to Prague; the p-book and RecSys Atlas open the field to newcomers.
